purpose: Square 40x40 rounded outline arrow control (chevron, with a line that fades in on hover). Used as carousel previous/next.

states.hover: desktop only (md:group-hover): chevron translate-x from -0.15em to 0 and the horizontal line opacity 0 -> 100, both 300ms

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule (no prefers-reduced-motion handling in the site): disable the chevron translate and line fade; keep colour change instant.

responsive.size: w-8 h-8 below 800px, md:w-7 md:h-7 from 800px
responsive.placement: CardCarousel shows the pair in the header row on md+ (hidden md:flex) and in a footer row on mobile (md:hidden)

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract

measuredFrom.quote: w-8 h-8 md:w-7 md:h-7 cursor-pointer text-charcoal transition-colors duration-300
